title: While We’re Here
subtitle: Small essays on attention, time, and being alive
author: Adam Hickey
backCoverLine: You can walk around a familiar lake believing almost nothing is happening, while simultaneously moving through thousands of invisible systems.
backCoverBlurb: Essays on attention, weather, water, machines that are learning to think, and the people who will not always be here. A book for reading straight through, or for opening at random on a Tuesday.
